# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest released version is supported with security fixes.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.

Report vulnerabilities privately via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/k8s-1/bashls/security/advisories/new) and email k8s-1.dev@proton.me.

Include:

- A description of the vulnerability and its impact
- Steps to reproduce
- `bashls` version affected

You should receive a response within a few days. If confirmed, a fix will be
released and the advisory published with credit to the reporter, unless
anonymity is requested.
